I have implemented type-safe window expressions support across all supported dialects on a new branch `feat/window-expressions` and committed all changes.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Window Expression Helpers & API ([`drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts))**:
   - **Ranking helpers**: [`rowNumber`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L182), [`rank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L186), [`denseRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L190), [`ntile`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L194), [`percentRank`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L202), [`cumeDist`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L206).
   - **Offset helpers**: [`lag`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L210), [`lead`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L225), [`firstValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L240), [`lastValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L244), [`nthValue`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L248).
   - **Aggregate helpers**: [`windowSum`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L257), [`windowAvg`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L261), [`windowMin`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L265), [`windowMax`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L269), [`windowCount`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L273).
   - **Frame constructors & boundary helpers**: [`rows`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L94), [`range`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L98), [`preceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L41), [`following`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L49), [`unboundedPreceding`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L36), [`currentRow`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L37), [`unboundedFollowing`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L38).
   - **Builder**: [`WindowBuilder`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/window.ts#L160) providing chainable `.over(specOrName)` with support for inline specifications (`partitionBy`, `orderBy`, `frame`, `baseWindow`) or named window references (`OVER <name>`).
   - **Typings**: Value-access functions type to `T | null`; `lag` and `lead` overloads strip `null` when a default value is supplied.
   - **Exports**: Exported via [`drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/index.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/sql/expressions/index.ts) up through [`drizzle-orm/src/index.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/src/index.ts).

2. **Query Builder `.window(name, spec)` & Dialect Compilers**:
   - Added chainable `.window(name, spec)` to select builders across all supported dialects (`pg-core`, `mysql-core`, `sqlite-core`, `singlestore-core`, `gel-core`).
   - Implemented validation rejecting empty names (`"non-empty"`) and whitespace-only names (`"whitespace"`).
   - Updated dialect select query compilation to emit the `WINDOW` clause preceding `ORDER BY`.

3. **Validation & SQL Constraints**:
   - Numeric positional arguments are emitted directly as literals (`sql.raw`) so they never become bound query parameters even when 0.
   - `ntile` and `nthValue` reject non-positive integer arguments with messages containing the helper name and value.
   - `preceding` and `following` validate that offsets are non-negative integers.
   - `rows` and `range` validate that boundary `from` does not follow `to`.
   - `windowCount()` without arguments generates `count(*)`.

4. **Testing & Verification**:
   - Added unit test suite in [`drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-dpufq9hj/drizzle-orm/tests/window.test.ts) covering all acceptance criteria, constraints, dialects, and typings.
   - Verified clean typecheck (`pnpm test:types`), export integrity (`tests/exports.test.ts`), build (`pnpm build`), and test suite (`vitest run`).
